claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack.
claims.evidence: The witness report identifies it as a hand pallet truck with wooden body and metal forks, but the load-capacity rating is not readable and no lifting test is shown.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete.
claims.evidence: No proof of operation is shown (no lift/hold test, no close-ups of levers/valves, no service records).
Brand/model text on the visible tag is not clearly readable; no serial/plate details are provided.

risks.risk: Hydraulics may not lift smoothly or may not hold load (leakage/weak pump), which directly affects usability and safety.
risks.proof: A short video of a full lift from ground to max height and a hold test (e.g., lift a known weight, stop pumping, show it stays up for 30–60 seconds).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (assume possible hydraulic leak/weak lift) and treat as a higher-risk used unit.

risks.risk: Forks may be bent, cracked, or have weak weld integrity; damage may not be obvious from a single angle.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of both forks along the full length (top and side views) plus any weld joints, with a straight-edge/level check shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case fork condition (possible repair needed) rather than assuming straight, safe forks.

risks.risk: Wheel/roller and bearing wear may cause rough movement, sticking, or failure under load.
risks.proof: Video of rolling over a flat surface and turning the handle to show smooth caster/roller rotation; include a close-up of wheel/roller condition.

risks.risk: Capacity rating (2.5 ton) may be incorrect or unreadable; using it beyond actual rating can be dangerous.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the capacity plate/label with readable tonnage and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown/possibly lower capacity until the rating is confirmed.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete controls (valves/levers, safety release, pump components) may prevent proper operation.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the handle controls/valves and underside/pump area showing all components present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (assume parts may be missing or non-functional).

risks.risk: Fitment risk: fork width/length may not match your pallet sizes, reducing efficiency or causing unsafe loading.
risks.proof: Tape-measure shots showing fork length, fork width, and overall pallet jack dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic fit/unknown dimensions (assume potential mismatch).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the capacity plate/label (tonnage must be readable).
Send a short video showing: lift test to near max height, then a hold test (no pumping) for 30–60 seconds.
Send close-up clips of both forks (top and side) including weld joints; show they are straight (straight-edge/level check).
Send a video of rolling on a flat surface showing smooth movement and caster/roller rotation.
Send close-up photos of the handle/valves/levers and the pump area to confirm all controls are present and functional.
Send measurements: fork length, fork width, and overall dimensions (with a tape).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type (hand pallet truck/pallet jack) but key working and capacity details are not verifiable from the report; still, a worst-case used-unit valuation is possible based on visible wear and unknown hydraulics.
